AnnotationsCategorySelect.label: Category
AnnotationsCategorySelect.description: Classify the event by what happened. This does not identify who caused it or change who can view it.

AnnotationsImpactInput.label: Operational or data impact
AnnotationsImpactInput.description: Describe the observed effects on services or data, separately from what happened.
AnnotationsImpactInput.placeholder: E.g. Delays on affected lines and missing real-time messages

AnnotationsLocationsSelect.label: Geographic scope
AnnotationsLocationsSelect.description: Select one or more countries, districts or regions, municipalities, or parishes from the available hierarchy. Each checked place is saved as selected; selecting a country does not select every locality. Locations describe where the event occurred and do not change affected operators or visibility.
AnnotationsLocationsSelect.load_error: Locations could not be loaded. Saved selections have been kept.

AnnotationsListFilterLocations.label: Location
AnnotationsListFilterLocations.description: Includes contained places and broader geographic scopes.

AnnotationsEmptyState.title: Annotations
AnnotationsEmptyState.description: Annotations record events that help explain changes in transport operations and data, such as weather conditions, strikes, accidents or technology failures.
AnnotationsEmptyState.context: Each event brings together dates, locations, operators, sources and observed impacts, preserving context for analysis and follow-up.

AnnotationsSourcesInput.label: Sources
AnnotationsSourcesInput.description: Add news articles, emails or other references. Each source needs a name or a URL.

AnnotationsSourceRow.name: Name or reference
AnnotationsSourceRow.name_placeholder: E.g. Strike news article or email subject
